decision.reason: [ev-a344853c8f30] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that Loki 3.0.0 "allows custom usage trackers for ingested and discarded bytes metric" and points to PR 11840 for details. It doesn't name what the change actually adds: a config key, a flag, a Go interface or extension point, or which component it lives in. It also doesn't say whether the existing metric's behaviour changes, or which deployments (for example, embedders versus binary users) are affected. Writing the subject, change and applicability needs the PR or matching docs and config reference text.
